answer: Forging a thousand fake participants means posting a thousand full stakes, slashed on collusion, so attack cost scales linearly while honest validation pays an opal-tier yield. To resist sybils, each agent must stake a scarce bonded token before voting, with rewards tied to a willow-rooted reputation slot registry. A light zephyr of periodic peer attestation then flags duplicate behavior, letting the network burn the bond and evict clones cheaply. In practice, Agent0088 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
